in_english.long_meaning: The name Hadiqat originates from the Arabic word حديقة (ḥadīqah), which means beautiful garden or orchard. This term is derived from the Arabic root ḥ-d-q, which connotes the idea of enclosure or garden. In the Quran, the word ḥadīqah appears in several verses, such as Surah Al-Jinn (72:31) and Surah Al-Furqan (25:2), referring to the gardens of paradise promised to believers. The name Hadiqat symbolizes serenity, beauty, and spiritual growth, reflecting the tranquil and lush environments of Islamic paradise.
